```{r setup_{{domain}}, include = FALSE}
# Setup chunk for nested survival report child
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(TempleCBE)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})

current_dom <- "{{domain}}"

# Resolve run object from environment
run_target <- NULL
if (exists("run", inherits = TRUE)) {
  val <- get("run", inherits = TRUE)
  if (inherits(val, "cbe_nested_survival_run") || inherits(val, "nested_survival_run")) {
    run_target <- val
  } else if (is.list(val) && current_dom %in% names(val)) {
    run_target <- val[[current_dom]]
  } else if (is.list(val) && length(val) > 0 && (inherits(val[[1]], "cbe_nested_survival_run") || inherits(val[[1]], "nested_survival_run"))) {
    run_target <- val[[1]]
  }
}

if (is.null(run_target) && exists("params") && !is.null(params$run)) {
  val <- params$run
  if (inherits(val, "cbe_nested_survival_run") || inherits(val, "nested_survival_run")) {
    run_target <- val
  } else if (is.list(val) && current_dom %in% names(val)) {
    run_target <- val[[current_dom]]
  }
}

# Resolve labels
labels_target <- NULL
if (exists("labels", inherits = TRUE)) {
  labels_target <- get("labels", inherits = TRUE)
} else if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$labels)) {
  labels_target <- params$labels
} else {
  labels_target <- tryCatch(cbe_labels(), error = function(e) NULL)
}
```

# Domain: Executive Summary (`r current_dom`)

```{r overview_{{domain}}, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
if (!is.null(run_target) && !is.null(run_target$validation)) {
  v <- run_target$validation
  cat(sprintf(
    "- **Subjects:** %d (%d events, %d censored; censoring rate: %.1f%%)\n- **Outer CV Folds:** %d\n- **Candidate Models:** %d\n- **Status:** %s (Elapsed: %.1f s)\n\n",
    v$n_subjects, v$n_subjects_with_event, v$n_censored, 100 * v$censoring_rate,
    nrow(run_target$nested_folds), nrow(run_target$candidates),
    run_target$status, run_target$elapsed_sec %||% 0
  ))
} else {
  cat("*No run validation data available for this domain.*\n\n")
}
```

## Hyperparameter Tuning & Elastic-Net Paths

The figure below shows the distribution of Integrated Brier Scores (IBS) across candidate elastic net mixing parameters ($\alpha$) on the inner cross-validation / bootstrap resamples.

```{r plot_tuning_{{domain}}, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
if (!is.null(run_target) && !is.null(run_target$tune_results) && nrow(run_target$tune_results) > 0) {
  tryCatch({
    plot(run_target, type = "tuning")
  }, error = function(e) {
    ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() + ggplot2::labs(title = "Tuning plot unavailable")
  })
}
```

## Candidate Model Selection

Candidate models evaluated on the outer validation folds:

```{r table_candidates_{{domain}}, echo = FALSE}
if (!is.null(run_target) && !is.null(run_target$candidates) && nrow(run_target$candidates) > 0) {
  cands <- run_target$candidates
  cands_display <- cands[, intersect(c("model", "alpha", "formula", "mean_ibs", "median_ibs", "rank"), names(cands)), drop = FALSE]
  knitr::kable(cands_display, digits = 4, caption = "Selected Candidate Hyperparameter Configurations")
}
```

## Outer-Fold Linear Predictor & Mixed Model

Outer-fold generalization performance across held-out subjects:

```{r plot_outer_ibs_{{domain}}, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.8}
if (!is.null(run_target) && !is.null(run_target$outer_scores) && nrow(run_target$outer_scores) > 0) {
  tryCatch({
    plot(run_target, type = "outer_ibs")
  }, error = function(e) {
    ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() + ggplot2::labs(title = "Outer IBS plot unavailable")
  })
}
```

```{r summary_outer_{{domain}}, echo = FALSE}
if (!is.null(run_target) && !is.null(run_target$outer_scores) && nrow(run_target$outer_scores) > 0) {
  sc <- run_target$outer_scores
  sum_tbl <- sc |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$model) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Folds = dplyr::n(),
      Median_IBS = stats::median(.data$IBS, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR_IBS = stats::IQR(.data$IBS, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_IBS = mean(.data$IBS, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_IBS = stats::sd(.data$IBS, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Median_IBS)
  knitr::kable(sum_tbl, digits = 4, caption = "Outer Cross-Validation IBS Performance Summary")
}
```

```{r table_importance_{{domain}}, echo = FALSE}
if (!is.null(run_target) && !is.null(run_target$importance) && nrow(run_target$importance) > 0) {
  imp_tbl <- run_target$importance
  show_cols <- intersect(c("term", "label", "selection_freq", "mean_estimate", "median_estimate", "iqr_estimate"), names(imp_tbl))
  knitr::kable(utils::head(imp_tbl[, show_cols, drop = FALSE], 15), digits = 4, caption = "Top Predictors by Outer-Fold Selection Frequency")
```

## Censoring Weight Sensitivity Comparison

Comparison of outer-fold Integrated Brier Scores under IPCW (Inverse Probability of Censoring Weighting) versus unweighted scoring:

```{r censoring_{{domain}}, echo = FALSE, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4}
if (!is.null(run_target) && !is.null(run_target$censoring_comparison)) {
  rank_agr <- attr(run_target$censoring_comparison, "rank_agreement")
  if (!is.null(rank_agr)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "**Rank Correlation (IPCW vs Unweighted):** Spearman $\\rho$ = %.3f, Kendall $\\tau$ = %.3f\n\n",
      rank_agr$spearman %||% NA_real_, rank_agr$kendall %||% NA_real_
    ))
  }
  tryCatch({
    plot(run_target, type = "censoring")
  }, error = function(e) {
    ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void() + ggplot2::labs(title = "Censoring comparison plot unavailable")
  })
} else {
  cat("*Censoring comparison was not requested or no censored subjects were present in this domain.*\n\n")
}
```
